item.title: FBI Arrests Meghan Markle’s Father, Neocons’ Pathetic Attempt to SPIN Iran War, Plus Crazy Fallout Continues Over Amy Griffin’s Memoir | Ep. 1436 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly discusses the breaking news of Meghan Markle’s father, Thomas Markle Sr, arrested in Florida and charged with possessing CSAM, the dark details behind the affidavit, Meghan Markle finally declining to comment on father’s arrest after rushing to the press, the latest developments following Russell Brand’s guilty verdict on multiple counts of s*xual assault, reports on his first night in prison, the neocons’ attempt to spin the Iran war after cheering from the beginning, the ridiculous fallout over VP JD Vance’s tweet about the midterm results, Donald Trump Jr. speaking out about the midterm results, Amy Griffin’s memoir, “The Tell,”  where she recounts allegations of s*xual abuse, the lawsuit filed by former middle-school classmate Joleene Altum, who alleges Griffin appropriated her traumatic experiences for the memoir, the specific stories at the center of the controversy, and more. Plus, Zach Rosenblatt, attorney of Joleene Altum, joins to discuss why his client’s allegations against Amy Griffin should be believed, the claims being labeled false, and more.
